This figurine is 3D printed, and only these filament colors exist: white (#FFFFFF), black (#000000), gray (#8E9089), red (#C12E1F), orange (#FF6A13), yellow (#F4EE2A), green (#00AE42), blue (#0A2989), purple (#5E43B7), pink (#F5547C), brown (#9D432C), beige (#F7E6DE), light skin (#EBC8B0). No other color can be printed. Use at most 4 of them on the whole figurine, counting the base and small details such as eyes, mouth and buttons. Do not reproduce colors from the request or the reference that are not on the list, such as turquoise, teal, gold, tan or light blue: repaint them in the closest listed color, even if that changes how it looks. Each part is one uniform matte color but stays a sculpted 3D form with volume, never a flat drawing. The white background does not count as a color. Do not draw the list, color swatches or any text.

Turn the main subject of this reference image into a 3D model from a modern animated family movie: soft rounded stylized forms, clean smooth materials, a warm friendly look. Keep it recognizably the same: same features, hair, clothing and distinctive details, and do not add anyone or anything that is not in the reference. If the subject is one person, or two people side by side, give them a head only slightly larger than realistic and large expressive eyes, and show them full body, standing with the arms relaxed at the sides, even if the photo shows only part of them. An animal stays an animal, with its natural body and a friendly cartoon face with big expressive eyes. If the subject is an object, vehicle or building, show only that thing as a rounded stylized model, with no people, no face, no eyes, no arms and no legs. Ignore the background and whatever is underneath the subject. Whole subject alone, centered and large, with a clear white margin on every side so that nothing touches the edge of the image, isolated on a plain white background with a soft contact shadow and no base or pedestal.
